description: Send outbound email as marvin@iancoley.org via Mailgun, read the Marvin label on Ian's Gmail via IMAP, and mark messages in that label read/unread

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from marvin@iancoley.org via Mailgun. Ian is always bcc'd automatically (not something a caller can opt out of) since Mailgun sends don't leave any trace in his own Gmail. Requires MAILGUN_API_KEY and MAILGUN_DOMAIN in config/.env.

to.description: Recipient email address, or a list of addresses to send one message to multiple recipients (each will see the others in the To: header — use cc/bcc if that visibility isn't wanted)

cc.description: CC address, or a list of addresses — visible to all recipients in the Cc: header

bcc.description: BCC address, or a list of addresses — hidden from every other recipient (Mailgun strips it from headers other recipients see)

from_name.description: Display name for the From header (default: Marvin)

tools.name: read_marvin_folder
tools.description: Read new messages from the 'Marvin' label in Ian's Gmail via IMAP. Returns only messages not seen on a previous call (tracked by UID in a local state file). Each genuinely-new message also creates a taskboard entry (source=email-intake) so it has to be explicitly closed out rather than just noted; completing that task marks the message read via mark_email_read. Doesn't touch Gmail's read state itself — that only happens via mark_email_read. Requires GMAIL_ADDRESS and GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD in config/.env.

include_seen.description: If true, return every message in the folder regardless of what's already been processed (default: false — only new messages since the last call)

tools.name: mark_email_read
tools.description: Flip the \Seen flag on one message in the 'Marvin' Gmail label — mark it read (default) or unread. Scoped to the Marvin folder only, same as read_marvin_folder; added 2026-09-01 per Ian's explicit sign-off to use Gmail's own read state as a record of what's been addressed. Requires GMAIL_ADDRESS and GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD in config/.env.

uid.description: The message's IMAP UID within the Marvin folder (as returned by read_marvin_folder)

read.description: true to mark read (default), false to mark unread
